Verification page (lean-pkg)

How to read the comparison status on this page. This page is generated by lean-pkg 0.29.0 and is reproduced without change. For a result whose coverage row also names definition claims (47 of the 99 results in Lean), it says "its statement was not compared by a second checker", and its summary line counts only the other 52, because the comparator compares theorem statements and not definitions. Every theorem claim that a row names is compared: all 1553 theorems of comparator.json, in the comparator receipt of this release. The definitions are checked by Lean's kernel in the build; the comparator's restated theorems mention verbatim copies of them (ChallengeDefs/), which scripts/comparator/CheckFidelity.lean checks to be equal to the project's.

How to read this page. Lean has checked every step of the proofs listed here. It cannot check that a Lean statement says what the paper says: that comparison is yours. For each result below, read the paper's statement beside the Lean statement, and check that the hypotheses match.

Corollary C:d1-first-calibration: First-moment calibration

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: out-of-scope, unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

Conclusion. A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves C_(1,*) = C_(2,*)/2^((4-alpha)/(3-alpha)) and 2C_(1,*) < C_(2,*) with nothing supplied, E:d1-first-calibration for random variables with the supplied mixed-moment expansion of P:mixed and the supplied first-moment series of the chaos expansion (solution not constructed), and the conditional rate clause for an abstract first moment; the P:Jensen comparison is commentary.

theorem first_calibration_paper {d : ℕ} {α α₀ : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d α α₀ Γ μ) (hα1 : α ≤ 1) (hV : 0 < (specV μ).toReal)
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {P : Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {u : Ω → ℝ} {t : ℝ}
    (ht : 0 < t) (hM : MixedMoment d α₀ Γ P X u t) (hF : FirstMomentSeries P X u) :
    (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∫ ω, X (2 * k) ω ∂P ≤
      (Zc α₀ * Kgen α (specV μ).toReal / 2 ^ (3 - α)) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
        ((k ! : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ ((2 - α) * k)) ∧
      (Zc α₀ * Kgen α (specV μ).toReal / 2 ^ (3 - α)) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
          ((k ! : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) ^ ((2 - α) * k)) ≤
        (Zc α₀ * Kgen α (specV μ).toReal / 2 ^ (3 - α)) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
          (k ! : ℝ) ^ (3 - α)) ∧
    ∫ ω, u ω ∂P ≤ Real.exp (C1 α α₀ (Kgen α (specV μ).toReal) * t ^ kappa α α₀) ∧
    C1 α α₀ (Kgen α (specV μ).toReal) =
      C2 α α₀ (Kgen α (specV μ).toReal) / 2 ^ ((4 - α) / (3 - α)) ∧
    2 * C1 α α₀ (Kgen α (specV μ).toReal) < C2 α α₀ (Kgen α (specV μ).toReal)

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: MixedMoment: the statement of P:mixed (main TeX lines 834-849); here it gives E X_n = sum_D J_(n,0,D)(t) (with X_0 = 1), the odd terms zero and the diagram limits; TRUE for the solution under H:homog; FirstMomentSeries: X_0 = 1, u integrable and E u = sum_n E X_n (main TeX line 796 and lines 5856-5857, "the L^2 expansion permits taking expectations of partial sums"); TRUE for the solution and its chaos terms.

Note. Wrappers LowAlphaUpper.first_calibration_paper (K_sp^gen, H:homog, alpha <= 1, V > 0), first_calibration_riesz_paper and first_calibration_white_paper (K_sp, d = 1; 0 < alpha_0 carried unused). The conditional clause is lower_rate_le, with "lower rate at least L" read as "for every L' < L, eventually E u(t) >= exp(L' t^kappa)". Models M4 (and M1 in d = 3).

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: for the order bounds (E:all-static-phase-orders, n >= 1; circle bound from L:complex-phase): FockSandwich (E:fock-sandwich in operator form), CPInputs (E:cp-input with the inverse-root integral) and PropagatorBlock (the weighted block map as M_z(h)), with positive A_0 and self-adjoint B at every cutoff (supplied, with the named inputs, in StaticInteractionCompleted); FockSandwich, A_0 >= 0 and B = B^* are proved in wave L12 on the Fourier-side model (FockSandwichModel.static_interaction_model_paper), with the added restriction of an orthonormal real family psi_m of size m in L^2(mu_eps) for every Gaussian cutoff m (so mu != 0; the case mu = 0, where every positive-order term vanishes, lines 3126-3127, is not covered by that wrapper); the remaining inputs of P:static-phase-all-orders for the order bounds: entireness in the coupling, the coefficient identification, the band and the cutoff removals (see that row); the free estimate ||S_0(-+h)||_lambda <= sqrt(e), the group law S_0(-h) S_0(h) = 1, Z_0 = S_0(h)(f,g) and the norm comparisons ||Z_n||_lambda <= (lambda h)^(-1) ||Z_n||_(1/h), ||(f,g)||_(1/h) <= ||(f,g)||_lambda (lines 3273-3292); an abstract complete real inner product space stands for L^2(Omega; X_lambda); Gaussian symmetry, E<Y_r, Y_s>_lambda = 0 for r + s odd (line 3293); the first-variance bounds of P:static-phase-variance, E||Y_1||^2 <= e E:phase-born and |E<Y_0, Y_2>| <= N sqrt(e) E:phase-mean (lines 3275-3280); for E:independent-static-blocks, the per-block bound ||I_j y||^2 <= (1 + E(h_j, sigma_j, lambda)) ||y||^2 on phases adapted to the past (E:static-interaction with density and tensoring with the independent past, lines 3333-3337), adaptation being an abstract predicate preserved by each block, and ||S_0(h_j)||^2 <= e^(lambda h_j).

Note. Wrappers static_interaction_completed_paper and independent_static_blocks_operator_paper state R_alpha, D_Gamma by E:phase-constants under the class of S:static-phase (only 0 < alpha < 2 is used; local finiteness is carried); the identification I = sum sigma^n Y_n and the per-block step are proved. E:static-block-series is proved with nothing supplied.

A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves, with the corollary's hypotheses, that the product and Riesz targets are nonzero covariances with scaling 3 - alpha whose endpoints satisfy H:three-endpoints, and, from the supplied P:three-transfer, the coefficient, moment and asymptotic bounds for an abstract model of A_k(t), E u^2 and M_st; the asymptotic bound is for every spectral measure of the low endpoint.

theorem three_product_riesz_paper_proved (Mdl : ThreeMomentModel) {α₀ α c : ℝ}
    (hT : ThreeTransfer Mdl α₀ (midTheta α₀ α))
    (hα₀ : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hα1 : 1 < α) (hα2 : α < 2 - α₀) (hc : 0 < c) :
    (∀ a : Fin 3 → ℝ, (∀ j, 0 ≤ a j ∧ a j < 1) → ∑ j, a j = α →
      TransferConclusion Mdl α₀ α (midTheta α₀ α) (prodRieszMeasure c a)
        (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec (midTheta α₀ α) a))
        (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec (midTheta α₀ α) a))) ∧
    TransferConclusion Mdl α₀ α (midTheta α₀ α) (rieszMeasure c α) (rieszMeasure c 1)
      (rieszMeasure c (chi α (midTheta α₀ α)))

Note. For 0 < a < 1, T > 0 and every real or complex f in L^2(0,T), Lean proves that the integrand is integrable on [0,T]^2 and that the double integral is at most 2 T^(1-a)/(1-a) times the squared L^2 norm, and the same bound for the norm in the completion H_a (TimeCompletion.emb_norm_sq_le) and for its continuous extension on L^2 classes.

theorem complex_phase_paper (A0 B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA0 : A0.IsPositive) (_hB : IsSelfAdjoint B)
    {a d : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hsand : ∀ ρ > 0, ‖invSqrtShift A0 ρ * B * invSqrtShift A0 ρ‖ ≤ d * ρ ^ (a - 2))
    {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam) {z : ℂ} (hz : ‖z‖ ≤ deltaA a * lam ^ (2 - a) / d)
    {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 ≤ h) (Cop Fop Hop : H →L[ℂ] H)
    (hCPC : ∀ M ≥ 0, (∀ w ∈ numRange (A0 - z • B), ‖phaseC h w‖ ≤ M) → ‖Cop‖ ≤ (1 + √2) * M)
    (hCPF : ∀ M ≥ 0, (∀ w ∈ numRange (A0 - z • B), ‖phaseF h lam w‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖Fop‖ ≤ (1 + √2) * M)
    (hCPH : ∀ M ≥ 0, (∀ w ∈ numRange (A0 - z • B), ‖phaseH h lam w‖ ≤ M) →
      ‖Hop‖ ≤ (1 + √2) * M)
    (Q' : H →L[ℂ] H) (J : ℝ → H →L[ℂ] H) (hJm : AEStronglyMeasurable J (volume.restrict (Ioi 0)))
    (hJ : ∀ t ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ),
      ‖J t‖ ≤ ‖z‖ * d / (1 - deltaA a) * (t ^ (-(1 / 2 : ℝ)) * (lam ^ 2 + t) ^ ((a - 3) / 2)))
    (hQ' : Q' - 1 = (1 / π) • ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), J t) :
    (∀ w ∈ numRange (A0 - z • B), PhaseRangeBounds a (deltaA a) lam h w) ∧
      ‖Cop‖ ≤ 3 * Real.exp (lam * h) ∧ ‖Fop‖ ≤ 6 * (1 + lam * h) * Real.exp (lam * h) ∧
      ‖Hop‖ ≤ 6 * Real.exp (lam * h) ∧ ‖Q' - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 6 ∧ IsUnit Q' ∧
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q'‖ ≤ 7 / 6 ∧
      ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Ring.inverse Q')‖ ≤ 6 / 5 ∧
      ∀ u v : H,
        √(‖Cop u + (Fop ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q') v‖ ^ 2 +
            ‖(-(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Ring.inverse Q') ∘L Hop)) u +
              (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (Ring.inverse Q') ∘L Cop ∘L
                ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint Q') v‖ ^ 2) ≤
          100 * Real.exp (2 * (lam * h)) * √(‖u‖ ^ 2 + ‖v‖ ^ 2)

theorem alpha_one_convolution_paper_completed {d : ℕ} {alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d 1 alpha0 Γ μ) :
    μ (closedBall 0 1) < ⊤ ∧
      ∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → ∀ z : Rd d,
        Integrable (fun y => conv Γ (heatK ε) (y + z)) (smoothedGreen (waveGreen d) h η) ∧
        (∀ v : ℝ, IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => Real.exp (-((ε + η) / 2 * r ^ 2)) *
          (Real.sin (h * r) / r) * Real.cos (r * v)) (Ioi 0)) ∧
        Integrable (fun θ : Rd d => Ia ((ε + η) / 2) h (inner ℝ θ z)) (sphereMeasure μ) ∧
        ∫ y, conv Γ (heatK ε) (y + z) ∂(smoothedGreen (waveGreen d) h η) =
          ∫ θ, Ia ((ε + η) / 2) h (inner ℝ θ z) ∂(sphereMeasure μ) ∧
        0 ≤ ∫ y, conv Γ (heatK ε) (y + z) ∂(smoothedGreen (waveGreen d) h η) ∧
        ∫ y, conv Γ (heatK ε) (y + z) ∂(smoothedGreen (waveGreen d) h η) ≤
          π * (μ (closedBall 0 1)).toReal / 2

theorem damped_homogeneous_norms_full_wave {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (h : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) :
    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ →
      (Integrable (N2integrand (d := d) alpha0 θ) (P2.prod μ) ∧
        Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Real.exp (-(θ * (p.1 + p.2))) * |p.1 - p.2| ^ (-alpha0) *
          ∫ ξ, waveHat p.1 ξ * waveHat p.2 ξ ∂μ) P2 ∧
        Integrable (fun l : ℝ => l ^ (alpha0 - 1) * resolvent μ (θ + l)) L0) ∧
      0 ≤ N2sq alpha0 θ μ ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun s => Real.exp (-(θ * s)) * (waveGreen d s univ).toReal) (Ioi 0) ∧
      N0 (waveGreen d) θ = θ ^ (-(2 : ℝ)) ∧
      N1 alpha0 θ μ = θ ^ (alpha + alpha0 - 2) * N1 alpha0 1 μ ∧
      N2sq alpha0 θ μ = θ ^ (-(4 - alpha - alpha0)) * N2sq alpha0 1 μ) ∧
    (∀ M : ℝ, Integrable (N2onIntegrand (d := d) alpha0 1 (Ioi M)) (P2.prod μ) ∧
      Integrable (N2onOuter alpha0 1 (Ioi M) μ) P2 ∧ 0 ≤ N2tailSq alpha0 M μ) ∧
    Tendsto (fun M => N1tail alpha0 M μ) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun M => N2tailSq alpha0 M μ) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    Tendsto (fun M => N2tail alpha0 M μ) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ → ∀ g : Rd d → ℝ≥0, IsMultiplier g →
      ∀ S S' : Set ℝ, MeasurableSet S → MeasurableSet S' → S ⊆ S' →
        Integrable (fun l : ℝ => l ^ (alpha0 - 1) * resolvent (smoothed μ g) (θ + l)) L0 ∧
        0 ≤ N1on alpha0 θ S (smoothed μ g) ∧
        N1on alpha0 θ S (smoothed μ g) ≤ N1on alpha0 θ S' μ ∧
        Integrable (N2onOuter alpha0 θ S (smoothed μ g)) P2 ∧
        Integrable (N2onOuter alpha0 θ S' μ) P2 ∧
        0 ≤ N2onSq alpha0 θ S (smoothed μ g) ∧
        N2onSq alpha0 θ S (smoothed μ g) ≤ N2onSq alpha0 θ S' μ) ∧
    (∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ η → IsMultiplier (gaussMult (d := d) η)) ∧

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: E:interval-column (main TeX lines 3388-3391) for the modes of each color at every rho > 0, as the named input FockColumn of FockForm; the segment bound of L:interval-complex for the background propagators, ||P_z(t,s)|| <= 100 e^(2 Lambda (t-s)) on every interval free of background endpoints, as applied in E:split-segment-product (lines 3791-3801; SegmentBound); its operator theory is not formalized; E:interval-cross-cube (lines 3937-3960) on the torus of the background radii, with the integrability of the word on each simplex (DysonCrossCube); variation of constants is not formalized; the invariance of every cross subspace Z_S under the background propagator (lines 3855-3859; BackgroundPreserves) and the absolute convergence of the ordinary coefficients on every polydisc (lines 3729-3733; EntireCoefficients); the cutoff evolution, its propagators and the coefficients U_r v are not constructed.

Note. Under H:homog (R = R_alpha carried, unused; alpha < 2), sigma_i > 0, any delta > 0 (not delta_(alpha/2)). S_rho = A_rho^(-1/2) symmetric, norm <= 1/rho, spectral comparison; M_e symmetric; S_b symmetric idempotent commuting with S_rho: assumed TeX properties. hQ is no hypothesis here: the P:interval-coefficients assembly adds it in FixedSplit (accepted 2026-11-12); FiniteWordCutoff removes it.

Lemma L:fock-form: Gaussian cutoff form bound

Conclusion. A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves, with the lemma's hypotheses and nothing supplied, E:fock-sandwich, in coefficient form and as an operator-norm bound with A_0 >= 0 and B bounded self-adjoint on the cutoff Hilbert space, uniformly in eps, m and the band, for finitely many real modes, Hermite degree at most N in the m multiplied coordinates, on a Fourier-side model not identified with the physical-space operators.

theorem fock_sandwich_paper {alpha R ε : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd 3)}
    (hPC : PhaseCovariance alpha Γ μ)
    (hRdef : R = alpha * π * (μ (Metric.ball 0 1)).toReal / (2 * Real.sin (π * alpha / 2)))
    (hε : 0 < ε) (ψ : Fin m → Lp ℂ 2 (nuEps μ ε)) (hψ : Orthonormal ℂ ψ)
    (hreal : ∀ i, ∀ᵐ ξ ∂(nuEps μ ε), ψ i (-ξ) = conj (ψ i ξ)) (N : ℕ) (b : ℝ) :
    let A0 := opA0 (d := 3) (m := m) (N := N) b
    let B := fieldB (N := N) b (nuEps_finite hPC.μ_tempered hε) ψ hψ
    let P := toH (m := m) (N := N) (diagOp (bandProj (d := 3) b))
    A0.IsPositive ∧ IsSelfAdjoint B ∧ (P * B = B ∧ B * P = B) ∧
      (∀ ρ (hρ : 0 < ρ), invSqrtShift A0 ρ * P = toH (diagOp (sqrtResolvent ρ hρ)) * P) ∧
      FockSandwich A0 B (fockD N R) (alpha / 2)

theorem fockSandwich_model {alpha ε : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd 3)}
    (hPC : PhaseCovariance alpha Γ μ) (hε : 0 < ε) (ψ : Fin m → Lp ℂ 2 (nuEps μ ε))

theorem gaussian_trace_bounds_paper {B Y : Matrix n n ℂ} (hB : B.IsHermitian)
    (hY : Y.IsHermitian) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    (∀ q : ℕ, q ≤ 2 * m - 2 →
      (trace (B * Y ^ q * B * Y ^ (2 * m - 2 - q))).re ≤
          (trace (B ^ 2 * CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m - 2))).re ∧
        (trace (B ^ 2 * CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m - 2))).im = 0) ∧
    (∀ D : Matrix n n ℂ, D.PosSemidef →
      (trace (D * CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m - 2))).re ≤
          (trace (D ^ m)).re ^ (1 / (m : ℝ)) *
            (trace (CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m))).re ^ (((m : ℝ) - 1) / m) ∧
        (trace (D * CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m - 2))).im = 0 ∧ (trace (D ^ m)).im = 0 ∧
        (trace (CFC.abs Y ^ (2 * m))).im = 0)

theorem interval_contractions_paper [CompleteSpace X] {d : ℕ} {alpha alpha0 R ε ρ : ℝ}
    {Γ μ : Measure (HomogHypothesis.Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogHypothesis.HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ)
    (hRdef : R = alpha * π * (μ (Metric.ball 0 1)).toReal / (2 * Real.sin (π * alpha / 2)))
    (_hε : 0 < ε) (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (S : X →L[ℂ] X) (hS : IsSelfAdjoint S) (hSn : ∀ f, ‖S f‖ ≤ ρ⁻¹ * ‖f‖)
    (M : Fin m → X →L[ℂ] X) (hM : ∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (M i))
    (hcol : FockColumn (fun i => S ∘L M i) (R * ρ ^ (alpha - 2)))
    (P : X →L[ℂ] X) (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) (hPP : P ∘L P = P) (hPS : P ∘L S = S ∘L P) :
    FockColumn (fun i => S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P)) (R * ρ ^ (alpha - 2)) ∧
      (∀ u w : X,
        Integrable (fun x => ‖∑ i, ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ) • (S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P)) u‖ ^ 2)
          (GaussianIBP.stdPi m) ∧
        ∫ x, ‖∑ i, ((x i : ℝ) : ℂ) • (S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P)) u‖ ^ 2 ∂GaussianIBP.stdPi m =
          ∑ i, ‖(S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P)) u‖ ^ 2 ∧
        ∑ i, ‖(S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P)) u‖ ^ 2 ≤ R * ρ ^ (alpha - 2) * (‖u‖ ^ 2 + ‖S w‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsSelfAdjoint (S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P) ∘L S)) ∧
      FockColumn (fun i => S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P) ∘L S) (R * ρ ^ (alpha - 4)) ∧
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (v : (Fin m → ℕ) → X), Supp N v →
        ∑ k ∈ degLE m N, ‖fieldOp (fun i => S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P) ∘L S) v k‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (StaticPhaseCauchy.fockD N R * ρ ^ (alpha / 2 - 2)) ^ 2 *
            ∑ k ∈ degLE m N, ‖v k‖ ^ 2 ∧
        Integrable (fun x => ‖iota N (fieldOp (fun i => S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P) ∘L S) v) x‖ ^ 2)
          (GaussianIBP.stdPi m) ∧
        ∫ x, ‖iota N (fieldOp (fun i => S ∘L (P ∘L M i ∘L P) ∘L S) v) x‖ ^ 2
            ∂GaussianIBP.stdPi m ≤
          (StaticPhaseCauchy.fockD N R * ρ ^ (alpha / 2 - 2)) ^ 2 *
            ∫ x, ‖iota N v x‖ ^ 2 ∂GaussianIBP.stdPi m

theorem occupation_raw_square_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (hΓ : Γ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ (f h : Rd d → ℝ) (g k : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f g → IsH1Pair h k →
      sqPair Γ f h < ⊤ ∧
      ⟪Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) f, Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) h⟫ = (sqPair Γ f h).toReal) ∧
    (∀ (f : Rd d → ℝ) (g : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f g →
      ‖Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) f‖ ^ 2 = (sqPair Γ f f).toReal) ∧
    (∀ (u : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ) (v : ℕ → Rd d → Rd d) (f : Rd d → ℝ) (g : Rd d → Rd d),
      (∀ n, IsH1Pair (u n) (v n)) → IsH1Pair f g → H1Tendsto u v f g →
      Tendsto (fun n => Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) (u n)) atTop (𝓝 (Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) f))) ∧
    (∀ (f f' : Rd d → ℝ) (g : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f g → f =ᵐ[volume] f' →
      Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) f' = Q (SpData.ofHomog hH) f) ∧
    ∀ (G : ℝ → Rd d → ℝ) (DG : ℝ → Rd d → Rd d), IsOccField G DG →
      MemLp (sqField (SpData.ofHomog hH) G) 2 volI ∧
      ‖rho (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) G‖ ^ 2 =
        RawOccupationEnergy.A alpha0 Γ G ∧
      ∀ Ψ ∈ CPos d,
        ⟪incl (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) Ψ,
          rho (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) G⟫ =
          ∫ q, kern alpha0 (q.1 - q.2) *
            testSqPair (SpData.ofHomog hH) (fun x => Ψ (q.1, x)) (G q.2)
            ∂(timeMeasure.prod timeMeasure) ∧
        ⟪incl (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) Ψ,
          rho (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) G⟫ ≤
          Real.sqrt (rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ * RawOccupationEnergy.A alpha0 Γ G) ∧
        (∀ᵐ s ∂volI, Integrable fun x => VariationalDilation.mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s x * G s x ^ 2) ∧
        IntegrableOn (fun s => ∫ x, VariationalDilation.mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s x * G s x ^ 2)
          (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
        ⟪incl (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) Ψ,
          rho (TParams.ofHomog hH) (SpData.ofHomog hH) G⟫ =
          ∫ s in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∫ x, VariationalDilation.mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s x * G s x ^ 2

Lemma L:phase-bessel: Hilbert-valued finite Bessel inequality

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

In the paper. The statement is not quoted here; read it in the paper.

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.PhaseBessel.phase_bessel_paper in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/PhaseBessel.lean.

theorem phase_bessel_paper {d K : ℕ}
    {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]
    (_hsep : TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace H)
    {u : Fin K → Fin 2 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℂ}
    {g : Fin 2 → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → H}
    (hu : IsOrthonormalL2 volume u) (hg : ∀ j, MemLp (g j) 2 volume) :
    (∀ k, Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, u k j η • g j η)) ∧
      (∀ k, Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, conj (u k j η) • g j η)) ∧
      Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2) ∧
      ∑ k, ‖∫ η, ∑ j, u k j η • g j η‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ η, ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ∑ k, ‖∫ η, ∑ j, conj (u k j η) • g j η‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ η, ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.PhaseBessel.phase_bessel in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/PhaseBessel.lean.

theorem phase_bessel {u : ι → J → X → ℂ} {g : J → X → H}
    (hu : IsOrthonormalL2 μ u) (hg : ∀ j, MemLp (g j) 2 μ) :
    (∀ k, Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, u k j η • g j η) μ) ∧
      Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2) μ ∧
      ∑ k, ‖coeff μ u g k‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∫ η, ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.PhaseBessel.phase_bessel_conj in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/PhaseBessel.lean.

theorem phase_bessel_conj {u : ι → J → X → ℂ} {g : J → X → H}
    (hu : IsOrthonormalL2 μ u) (hg : ∀ j, MemLp (g j) 2 μ) :
    (∀ k, Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, conj (u k j η) • g j η) μ) ∧
      Integrable (fun η => ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2) μ ∧
      ∑ k, ‖∫ η, ∑ j, conj (u k j η) • g j η ∂μ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ∫ η, ∑ j, ‖g j η‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

theorem phase_contractions_paper_completed {alpha : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd 3)}
    (h : PhaseCovariance alpha Γ μ) :
    (∀ lam : ℝ, 0 < lam → ∀ q : Rd 3,
      Integrable (fun ξ : Rd 3 => 1 / (lam ^ 2 + ‖q + ξ‖ ^ 2)) μ ∧
        ∫ ξ, 1 / (lam ^ 2 + ‖q + ξ‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ralpha μ alpha * lam ^ (alpha - 2)) ∧
    (∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ q : Rd 3,
      (∀ x : Rd 3, Integrable (fun y => pdens (2 * ε) (x - y)) Γ ∧
        0 ≤ PhaseContractions.gammaEps Γ ε x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => Complex.exp (Complex.I * ((inner ℝ q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) *
          (PhaseContractions.gammaEps Γ ε x : ℂ)) (waveGreen 3 a) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : Rd 3 => (waveHat a (q + ξ) : ℂ) *
          (Real.exp (-(ε * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)) : ℂ)) μ ∧
        traceT Γ ε a q = ∫ ξ, (waveHat a (q + ξ) : ℂ) * (Real.exp (-(ε * ‖ξ‖ ^ 2)) : ℂ) ∂μ ∧
        ‖traceT Γ ε a q‖ ≤ dGam Γ alpha * a ^ (1 - alpha))

        ∫ ξ, 1 / (lam ^ 2 + ‖q + ξ‖ ^ 2) ∂μ ≤ ralpha μ alpha * lam ^ (alpha - 2)) ∧
    (∀ a : ℝ, 0 < a → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ q : Rd 3,

        ‖traceT Γ ε a q‖ ≤ dGam Γ alpha * a ^ (1 - alpha))

    (hα₀ : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hα1 : 1 < α) (hα2 : α < 2 - α₀) (hθ0 : α₀ < θ)

theorem positive_physical_gram_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (_hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (A : ι → Set ℝ) (hA : ∀ i, MeasurableSet (A i))
    (_hAI : ∀ i, A i ⊆ Ioo 0 1) (_hdisj : Pairwise (Function.onFun Disjoint A))
    (_hne : ∀ i, (A i).Nonempty) (_hpos : ∀ i, 0 < volume.real (A i))
    (_hsum : ∑ i, volume.real (A i) = 1)
    (f : ι → Rd d → ℝ) (hf : ∀ i, IsTestFunction (f i)) (_hf2 : ∀ i, ∫ x, f i x ^ 2 = 1)
    (η : Rd d → ℝ) (hη : ContDiff ℝ ∞ η) (_hη01 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ η x ∧ η x ≤ 1)
    (_hη1 : ∀ x, ‖x‖ ≤ 1 → η x = 1) (_hη2 : ∀ x, 2 < ‖x‖ → η x = 0) {R : ℝ} (_hR : 1 ≤ R) :
    let p : KernParams := ⟨alpha0, hH.alpha0_pos, hH.alpha0_lt_one⟩
    let qR : ι → Rd d → ℝ := fun i x => η (R⁻¹ • x) ^ 2 * f i x ^ 2
    let qI : ι → Rd d → ℝ := fun i x => f i x ^ 2
    let kR : ι → HI p (HGamma μ) := fun i => gramVec p μ (A i) (hA i) (qR i)
    let kI : ι → HI p (HGamma μ) := fun i => gramVec p μ (A i) (hA i) (qI i)
    (∀ i j, inner ℝ (kR i) (kR j) = tPair alpha0 (A i) (A j) * spatialPair Γ (qR i) (qR j)) ∧
    (∀ i j, inner ℝ (kI i) (kI j) = tPair alpha0 (A i) (A j) * spatialPair Γ (qI i) (qI j)) ∧
    (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (kR i) (kR j)).PosSemidef ∧
    (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (kI i) (kI j)).PosSemidef

Lemma L:product-endpoints: Strict product endpoints

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

In the paper. The statement is not quoted here; read it in the paper.

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.RieszPositiveDefinite.product_endpoints_paper_proved in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/RieszPositiveDefinite.lean.

theorem product_endpoints_paper_proved {a : Fin 3 → ℝ} {θ c : ℝ}
    (ha0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (ha1 : ∀ j, a j < 1) (hα1 : 1 < ∑ j, a j) (hα2 : ∑ j, a j < 2)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ : θ < 2 - ∑ j, a j) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((0 < lam θ a ∧ lam θ a < 1) ∧ ∑ j, bVec θ a j = 1 ∧
      ∑ j, vVec θ a j = chi (∑ j, a j) θ ∧
      (∀ j, a j = θ * bVec θ a j + (1 - θ) * vVec θ a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < a j → (0 < bVec θ a j ∧ bVec θ a j < 1) ∧
        (0 < vVec θ a j ∧ vVec θ a j < 1)) ∧
      (∀ j, a j = 0 → bVec θ a j = 0 ∧ vVec θ a j = 0)) ∧
    ((IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c a) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c a) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c a) (3 - ∑ j, a j)) ∧
      (IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a)) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c (bVec θ a)) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a)) 2) ∧
      (IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c (vVec θ a)) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) (3 - chi (∑ j, a j) θ)) ∧
      (∑ j, a j < chi (∑ j, a j) θ ∧ chi (∑ j, a j) θ < 2)) ∧
    GaussComparison θ (prodRieszMeasure c a) (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a))
      (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) ∧
    EndpointPair θ (chi (∑ j, a j) θ) (prodRieszMeasure c a) (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a))
      (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a))

theorem product_endpoints_paper (hPD : RieszProductPD) {a : Fin 3 → ℝ} {θ c : ℝ}
    (ha0 : ∀ j, 0 ≤ a j) (ha1 : ∀ j, a j < 1) (hα1 : 1 < ∑ j, a j) (hα2 : ∑ j, a j < 2)
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ : θ < 2 - ∑ j, a j) (hc : 0 < c) :
    ((0 < lam θ a ∧ lam θ a < 1) ∧ ∑ j, bVec θ a j = 1 ∧
      ∑ j, vVec θ a j = chi (∑ j, a j) θ ∧
      (∀ j, a j = θ * bVec θ a j + (1 - θ) * vVec θ a j) ∧
      (∀ j, 0 < a j → (0 < bVec θ a j ∧ bVec θ a j < 1) ∧
        (0 < vVec θ a j ∧ vVec θ a j < 1)) ∧
      (∀ j, a j = 0 → bVec θ a j = 0 ∧ vVec θ a j = 0)) ∧
    ((IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c a) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c a) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c a) (3 - ∑ j, a j)) ∧
      (IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a)) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c (bVec θ a)) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a)) 2) ∧
      (IsCov (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) ∧ LocallyIntegrable (prodRieszReal c (vVec θ a)) ∧
        Scaling (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) (3 - chi (∑ j, a j) θ)) ∧
      (∑ j, a j < chi (∑ j, a j) θ ∧ chi (∑ j, a j) θ < 2)) ∧
    GaussComparison θ (prodRieszMeasure c a) (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a))
      (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a)) ∧
    EndpointPair θ (chi (∑ j, a j) θ) (prodRieszMeasure c a) (prodRieszMeasure c (bVec θ a))
      (prodRieszMeasure c (vVec θ a))

theorem chain_cone (hϱ : ϱ < 1 / 2) {N : ℕ} {σ : ℕ → ℝ} (hσ : ∀ m ≤ N, σ m ∈ paramI)
    (hadj : ∀ m < N, |σ (m + 1) - σ m| ≤ K.ω) {D : ℕ → ℝ → F →L[ℝ] F}
    (hD : ∀ m ≤ N, ∀ u ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) K.B, ‖D m u - G.P (σ m) u‖ ≤ K.ε) :
    ∀ m : ℕ, m + 1 ≤ N →
      K.a / 2 * (1 - ϱ) ^ m *
          Real.exp ((K.B : ℝ) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), G.lam (σ k)) ≤
        G.ell (σ m) (chainState D K.B G.e0 (m + 1)) ∧
      0 < G.ell (σ m) (chainState D K.B G.e0 (m + 1)) ∧
      ‖G.Q (σ m) (chainState D K.B G.e0 (m + 1))‖ ≤
        K.ϑ * G.ell (σ m) (chainState D K.B G.e0 (m + 1))

theorem source_spatial_heat_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (_hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ f g : Rd d → ℝ, IsTestFunction f → IsTestFunction g →
      inner ℝ (vec μ f) (vec μ g) = spatialPair Γ f g ∧
      (spatialPair Γ f g : ℂ) =
        (((2 * Real.pi) ^ (d : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ, texHat f ξ * conj (texHat g ξ) ∂μ) ∧
    IsClosed (HGamma μ : Set (Lp ℂ 2 μ)) ∧ TopologicalSpace.SeparableSpace (HGamma μ) ∧
    (∀ f : SchwartzMap (Rd d) ℝ, MemLp (fourierQ f) 2 μ ∧ vec μ f ∈ HGamma μ ∧
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => vec μ (fun x => f x * cut n x)) atTop (𝓝 (vec μ f))) ∧
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → (heatH Γ μ ε).IsPositive ∧ IsSelfAdjoint (heatH Γ μ ε) ∧
      ‖heatH Γ μ ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧ ‖ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (HGamma μ) - heatH Γ μ ε‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (f : Rd d → ℝ) (hf : IsTestFunction f),
        (heatH Γ μ ε ⟨vec μ f, vec_mem_HGamma μ hf⟩ : Lp ℂ 2 μ) = vec μ (heatConv ε f)) ∧
    (∀ x : HGamma μ, Tendsto (fun ε => heatH Γ μ ε x) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 x))

theorem spatial_physical_pair_paper {d : ℕ} {alpha a : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha a Γ μ) (_hΓ : Γ ≠ 0) :
    SigmaFinite (pairMeasure Γ) ∧
    (∀ f f' h h' : Rd d → ℝ≥0∞, f =ᵐ[volume] f' → h =ᵐ[volume] h' →
      pairing Γ f h = pairing Γ f' h') ∧
    (∀ f h : Rd d → ℝ≥0∞, AEMeasurable f volume → AEMeasurable h volume →
      AEMeasurable (fun p : Rd d × Rd d => f p.1 * h (p.1 - p.2)) (pairMeasure Γ)) ∧
    (∀ (F : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ) (G : Rd d → ℝ),
      (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rd d)), Tendsto (fun n => F n x) atTop (nhds (G x))) →
      ∀ᵐ p ∂(pairMeasure Γ), Tendsto (fun n => F n p.1) atTop (nhds (G p.1)) ∧
        Tendsto (fun n => F n (p.1 - p.2)) atTop (nhds (G (p.1 - p.2))))

Lemma L:symplectic-free: Free wave form and compact Young baseline

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

Conclusion. A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves both compact-baseline displays on an abstract nonzero Hilbert space with a supplied free group, isometric velocity reversal and weakly vanishing translations, for a Young evolution given only by convergence of its left Young sums; it proves W_t^T J_symp W_t = J_symp per frequency and the force skewness for the L^2 pairing. J_E and the preservation of omega on E are not formalized.

In the paper. The statement is not quoted here; read it in the paper.

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: the free wave group on E = H^(1/2) x H^(-1/2) with its group law, the isometric velocity reversal with S_E(-h) = R S_E(h) R, and the spatial translations, isometric, commuting with S_E(h) and weakly null as |y| -> infinity (integrated_symplectic_phase.tex lines 121-145); E is an abstract nonzero real Hilbert space; P:constant-young-linear on L(E) (integrated_symplectic_phase.tex lines 105-112): the left Young sums of X over partitions of [s,t] converge in operator norm to U_X(t,s) - I; supplied in the weaker form of convergence along some nontrivial filter of finite node lists in [s,t] (no ordering, endpoint or mesh condition).

Note. The two displays are stated exactly as in the lemma, with its hypotheses (1/2 < theta < 1, compact-valued Hoelder paths starting at zero) and H:homog, which is used only for d >= 1; the force claim is the L^2 identity for smooth bounded b, with the cancellation integrand integrable.

      (IntegrableOn (density a) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
        ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t
          = Gamma ((1 + a) / 2) / (Gamma (1 + a) * Gamma ((1 - a) / 2))) ∧
      0 < ∫ t in Ioo (0:ℝ) 1, density a t

theorem partial_sum_mono_constructed_paper {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω₁]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω₂] (P₁ : Measure Ω₁) (P₂ : Measure Ω₂) [IsProbabilityMeasure P₁]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : Rd d)
    (W₁ : Pt d T → Ω₁ → ℝ) (K₁ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₁ : CenteredGaussianField W₁ K₁ P₁)
    (W₂ : Pt d T → Ω₂ → ℝ) (K₂ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₂ : CenteredGaussianField W₂ K₂ P₂)
    (hV₁fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₁ p p))
    (hV₂fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₂ p p))
    (hcell₁ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₁) (hcell₂ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₂)
    (h0 : ∀ p q, 0 ≤ K₁ p q) (h12 : ∀ p q, K₁ p q ≤ K₂ p q) :
    let ν : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure (Fin n → Pt d T) := fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x
    (∀ (r : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
      ∫ ω, ((∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW₁ n : Lp ℝ 2 P₁) ω) ^ 2 ∂P₁ ≤
        ∫ ω, ((∑ n ∈ range (N + 1), r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW₂ n : Lp ℝ 2 P₂) ω) ^ 2 ∂P₂) ∧
      ∀ r : ℝ,
        ∫ ω, ((∑' n, r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW₁ n : Lp ℝ 2 P₁) ω) ^ 2 ∂P₁ ≤
          ∫ ω, ((∑' n, r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW₂ n : Lp ℝ 2 P₂) ω) ^ 2 ∂P₂

    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ)

    (∀ r : ℂ, Summable (fun n => ‖r ^ n • toC (chainIntegral ν hW n)‖) ∧
      Summable (fun n => r ^ n • toC (chainIntegral ν hW n))) ∧
    (∀ (r : ℂ) (N : ℕ),

          ((∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    ∀ r : ℂ, Tendsto (fun N => ∑ m ∈ range N, ∑ n ∈ range N, r ^ m * conj r ^ n *

      (𝓝 ((∫ ω, ‖(∑' n, r ^ n • toC (chainIntegral ν hW n) : Lp ℂ 2 P) ω‖ ^ 2 ∂P : ℝ) : ℂ))

theorem terminal_wick_constructed_paper {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : Rd d) (W : Pt d T → Ω → ℝ) (K : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ)
    (hW : CenteredGaussianField W K P) (hVfin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K p p))
    (hcell : MeanSquareCellContinuous K) :
    let ν : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure (Fin n → Pt d T) := fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x
    (∀ n, Integrable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW z) (ν n)) ∧
      ((chainIntegral ν hW 0 : Ω → ℝ) =ᵐ[P] fun _ => 1) ∧
      (∀ n, ‖chainIntegral ν hW n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * n - 1).doubleFactorial) *
        (⨆ p, K p p) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (T ^ (2 * n) / (2 * n).factorial)) ∧
      (∀ m n, ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P =
        ∑ D ∈ pairings (univ : Finset (Fin (m + n))), pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
      (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)),
        Integrable (fun q : (Fin m → Pt d T) × (Fin n → Pt d T) =>
          pairWeight (fun a b => K (Fin.append q.1 q.2 a) (Fin.append q.1 q.2 b)) univ D)
          ((ν m).prod (ν n))) ∧
      (∀ m n, Odd (m + n) → ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) →
        (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)), 0 ≤ pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
        ∀ m n, 0 ≤ ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, Summable fun n => ‖r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW n‖) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) → ∀ r : ℝ,
        UniformSeriesTail.TerminalWickInput P (fun n => chainIntegral ν hW n) r)

    [MeasurableSpace Ω₂] (P₁ : Measure Ω₁) (P₂ : Measure Ω₂) [IsProbabilityMeasure P₁]
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : Rd d)
    (W₁ : Pt d T → Ω₁ → ℝ) (K₁ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₁ : CenteredGaussianField W₁ K₁ P₁)
    (W₂ : Pt d T → Ω₂ → ℝ) (K₂ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₂ : CenteredGaussianField W₂ K₂ P₂)
    (hV₁fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₁ p p))
    (hV₂fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₂ p p))
    (hcell₁ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₁) (hcell₂ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₂)

theorem chainMeasureRaw_apply (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (n : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (x : Rd d)
    {A : Set (Fin n → ℝ × Rd d)} (hA : MeasurableSet A) :
    chainMeasureRaw d n T x A =
      ∫⁻ s in {s : Fin n → ℝ | OpenSimplex T s},
        Measure.pi (fun j => waveGreen d (gap T s j)) {w | chainPoint x s w ∈ A}

theorem terminal_wick_regularization_paper {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : Rd d) (W : Pt d T → Ω → ℝ) (K : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ)
    (hW : CenteredGaussianField W K P) (hVfin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K p p))
    (hcell : MeanSquareCellContinuous K) :
    (∀ (η : ℝ) (n : ℕ), chainMeasureReg d n T hT.le x η univ = chainMass d n T) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : (Fin n → Pt d T) →ᵇ ℝ),
        Tendsto (fun η => ∫ z, f z ∂(chainMeasureReg d n T hT.le x η)) (𝓝[>] 0)
          (𝓝 (∫ z, f z ∂(chainMeasure d n T hT.le x)))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, Tendsto (fun η => chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasureReg d n T hT.le x η) hW n)
        (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x) hW n))) ∧
      (∀ m n : ℕ, Tendsto (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          ∫ ω, chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasureReg d n T hT.le x p.1) hW m ω *
            chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasureReg d n T hT.le x p.2) hW n ω ∂P)
        (𝓝[>] 0 ×ˢ 𝓝[>] 0)
        (𝓝 (∫ ω, chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x) hW m ω *
          chainIntegral (fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x) hW n ω ∂P)))

theorem terminal_wick_paper {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (W : Pt d T → Ω → ℝ) (K : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW : CenteredGaussianField W K P)
    (hVfin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K p p))
    (_hcell : MeanSquareCellContinuous K)
    (ν : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure (Fin n → Pt d T)) [∀ n, IsFiniteMeasure (ν n)]
    (hmass : ∀ n, ν n univ = chainMass d n T)
    (hmeas : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW z) (ν n))
    (hK : Measurable fun q : Pt d T × Pt d T => K q.1 q.2) :
    (∀ n, Integrable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW z) (ν n)) ∧
      ((chainIntegral ν hW 0 : Ω → ℝ) =ᵐ[P] fun _ => 1) ∧
      (∀ n, ‖chainIntegral ν hW n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * n - 1).doubleFactorial) *
        (⨆ p, K p p) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (T ^ (2 * n) / (2 * n).factorial)) ∧
      (∀ m n, ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P =
        ∑ D ∈ pairings (univ : Finset (Fin (m + n))), pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
      (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)), Integrable (fun q : (Fin m → Pt d T) × (Fin n → Pt d T) =>
        pairWeight (fun a b => K (Fin.append q.1 q.2 a) (Fin.append q.1 q.2 b)) univ D)
        ((ν m).prod (ν n))) ∧
      (∀ m n, Odd (m + n) → ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) →
        (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)), 0 ≤ pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
        ∀ m n, 0 ≤ ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, Summable fun n => ‖r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW n‖) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) → ∀ r : ℝ,
        UniformSeriesTail.TerminalWickInput P (fun n => chainIntegral ν hW n) r)

theorem terminal_wick_mono_paper {Ω₁ Ω₂ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω₁] [MeasurableSpace Ω₂]
    (P₁ : Measure Ω₁) (P₂ : Measure Ω₂) [IsProbabilityMeasure P₁] [IsProbabilityMeasure P₂]
    (d : ℕ) (_hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (W₁ : Pt d T → Ω₁ → ℝ) (K₁ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₁ : CenteredGaussianField W₁ K₁ P₁)
    (W₂ : Pt d T → Ω₂ → ℝ) (K₂ : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ) (hW₂ : CenteredGaussianField W₂ K₂ P₂)
    (hV₁fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₁ p p))
    (hV₂fin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K₂ p p))
    (_hcell₁ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₁) (_hcell₂ : MeanSquareCellContinuous K₂)
    (ν : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure (Fin n → Pt d T)) [∀ n, IsFiniteMeasure (ν n)]
    (_hmass : ∀ n, ν n univ = chainMass d n T)
    (hmeas₁ : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW₁ z) (ν n))
    (hmeas₂ : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW₂ z) (ν n))
    (h0 : ∀ p q, 0 ≤ K₁ p q) (h12 : ∀ p q, K₁ p q ≤ K₂ p q) (m n : ℕ) :
    ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW₁ m ω * chainIntegral ν hW₁ n ω ∂P₁ ≤
      ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW₂ m ω * chainIntegral ν hW₂ n ω ∂P₂

Note. Built g_n^{T,x} (M1 in d = 3), none supplied: partial-sum second moments compared, every order, real r (full series a corollary; false for complex r); L^2 absolute convergence, complex r. theorem rayleigh_tail_paper (G : ℝ → ℝ) (hG : Measurable G) (A₀ C ν M δ : ℝ)
    (hgrowth : ∀ r, 0 ≤ r → G r ≤ A₀ + C * r ^ ν)
    (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hν1 : 1 < ν) (hν2 : ν < 2) (hδ : 0 < δ) (_hδ1 : δ < 1)
    (hM : 0 < M) (hcut : 4 * C ≤ M ^ (2 - ν)) :
    IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r / δ * Real.exp ((G r - r ^ 2 / 2) / δ)) (Ioi M) ∧
      (∫ r in Ioi M, r / δ * Real.exp ((G r - r ^ 2 / 2) / δ) ≤
        4 * Real.exp ((A₀ - M ^ 2 / 4) / δ)) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun r : ℝ => r / δ * Real.exp ((G r - r ^ 2 / 2) / δ)) (Icc 0 M)

theorem terminal_wick_constructed_paper {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω)
    [IsProbabilityMeasure P] (d : ℕ) (hd : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T)
    (x : Rd d) (W : Pt d T → Ω → ℝ) (K : Pt d T → Pt d T → ℝ)
    (hW : CenteredGaussianField W K P) (hVfin : BddAbove (Set.range fun p => K p p))
    (hcell : MeanSquareCellContinuous K) :
    let ν : ∀ n : ℕ, Measure (Fin n → Pt d T) := fun n => chainMeasure d n T hT.le x
    (∀ n, Integrable (fun z : Fin n → Pt d T => prodL2 hW z) (ν n)) ∧
      ((chainIntegral ν hW 0 : Ω → ℝ) =ᵐ[P] fun _ => 1) ∧
      (∀ n, ‖chainIntegral ν hW n‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * n - 1).doubleFactorial) *
        (⨆ p, K p p) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (T ^ (2 * n) / (2 * n).factorial)) ∧
      (∀ m n, ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P =
        ∑ D ∈ pairings (univ : Finset (Fin (m + n))), pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
      (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)),
        Integrable (fun q : (Fin m → Pt d T) × (Fin n → Pt d T) =>
          pairWeight (fun a b => K (Fin.append q.1 q.2 a) (Fin.append q.1 q.2 b)) univ D)
          ((ν m).prod (ν n))) ∧
      (∀ m n, Odd (m + n) → ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P = 0) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) →
        (∀ m n (D : Fin (m + n) → Fin (m + n)), 0 ≤ pairingIntegral ν K m n D) ∧
        ∀ m n, 0 ≤ ∫ ω, chainIntegral ν hW m ω * chainIntegral ν hW n ω ∂P) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, Summable fun n => ‖r ^ n • chainIntegral ν hW n‖) ∧
      ((∀ p q, 0 ≤ K p q) → ∀ r : ℝ,
        UniformSeriesTail.TerminalWickInput P (fun n => chainIntegral ν hW n) r)

Lemma L:variational-control-dilation: Radon and Rayleigh dilation

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

Conclusion. A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves the bijection and the four identities with the section's hypotheses (H:homog, Gamma != 0, a = alpha0) and nothing supplied, for the variance in its integral form and the rate defined as the square root of the real Rayleigh supremum E:variational-real-rayleigh; their identification with E W(Psi)^2 (L:compact-raw-profile) and sqrt(-E_s) (P:variational-unmasked-rate) is not formalized.

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.variational_control_dilation_paper in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean.

theorem variational_control_dilation_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (_hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    Set.InvOn (dil alpha (1 / r)) (dil alpha r) (CPos d) (CPos d) ∧
      Set.BijOn (dil (d := d) alpha r) (CPos d) (CPos d) ∧
      ∀ Ψ ∈ CPos d,
        (∀ s x, mean alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) s x = r ^ 2 * mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s (r • x)) ∧
        rawCost alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) = r ^ (4 - alpha) * rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ ∧
        (∀ s, rate alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) s = r * rate alpha0 Γ Ψ s) ∧
        integratedRate alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) = r * integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ

In Lean. StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalDilation.variational_control_dilation_integrable_paper in StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalDilation.lean.

theorem variational_control_dilation_integrable_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ}
    {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)} (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (_hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (Ψ : ℝ × Rd d → ℝ) (hΨ : Ψ ∈ CPos d) :
    (∀ u x, Integrable (fun y => dil alpha r Ψ (u, x - y)) Γ ↔
      Integrable (fun y => Ψ (u, r • x - y)) Γ) ∧
    (∀ s x, IntegrableOn
        (fun u => |s - u| ^ (-alpha0) * conv Γ (fun y => dil alpha r Ψ (u, y)) x)
        (Set.Ioo 0 1) ↔
      IntegrableOn (fun u => |s - u| ^ (-alpha0) * conv Γ (fun y => Ψ (u, y)) (r • x))
        (Set.Ioo 0 1)) ∧
    (∀ σ, Integrable
        (fun x => dil alpha r Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) σ x) volume ↔
      Integrable (fun x => Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ Ψ σ x) volume) ∧
    (IntegrableOn
        (fun σ => ∫ x, dil alpha r Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) σ x)
        (Set.Ioo 0 1) ↔
      IntegrableOn (fun σ => ∫ x, Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ Ψ σ x) (Set.Ioo 0 1)) ∧
    (∀ s, WeakSobolev.rayleighSet (mean alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ) s) =
      (r ^ 2) • WeakSobolev.rayleighSet (mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s)) ∧
    (IntegrableOn (rate alpha0 Γ (dil alpha r Ψ)) (Set.Ioo 0 1) ↔
      IntegrableOn (rate alpha0 Γ Ψ) (Set.Ioo 0 1))

theorem white_clock_laplace_paper {a θ₁ θ₂ η₁ η₂ : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (ha1 : a < 1)
    (hθ₁ : 0 < θ₁) (hθ₂ : 0 < θ₂) (hη₁ : 0 < η₁) (hη₂ : 0 < η₂) :
    (IntegrableOn (crossIntegrand a θ₁ θ₂) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
      ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ),
          exp (-θ₁ * s - θ₂ * t) * |s - t| ^ (-a) * (min s t / 2) =
        Gamma (1 - a) / (2 * (θ₁ + θ₂) ^ 2) * (θ₁ ^ (a - 1) + θ₂ ^ (a - 1))) ∧
    (∀ θ : ℝ, 0 < θ →
      IntegrableOn (crossIntegrand a θ θ) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
        ∫ t in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ s in Ioi (0:ℝ),
            exp (-θ * s - θ * t) * |s - t| ^ (-a) * (min s t / 2) =
          Gamma (1 - a) / (4 * θ ^ (3 - a))) ∧
    (IntegrableOn (selfIntegrand a η₁ η₂) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧
      ∫ r₂ in Ioi (0:ℝ), ∫ r₁ in Ioi (0:ℝ),
          exp (-η₁ * r₁ - η₂ * r₂) * r₂ ^ (-a) * (r₁ / 2) =
        Gamma (1 - a) / (2 * η₁ ^ 2 * η₂ ^ (1 - a)))

theorem d1_upper_paper_riesz {c α α₀ t : ℝ} (_hα₀0 : 0 < α₀) (hα₀1 : α₀ < 1) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hα1 : α < 1) (ht : 0 < t) {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {P : Measure Ω} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {u : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : MixedMoment 1 α₀ (volume.withDensity (riesz c α)) P X u t) :
    (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
      coeffA (waveGreen 1) (covEps (volume.withDensity (riesz c α)) ε) α₀ k t ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
          (k ! * (k : ℝ) ^ ((2 - α) * k))) ∧
      coeffA (waveGreen 1) (covEps (volume.withDensity (riesz c α)) ε) α₀ k t ≤
        ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
          (k ! : ℝ) ^ (3 - α))) ∧
    (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (2 * k + 1), ∫ ω, X m ω * X (2 * k - m) ω ∂P ≤
        (2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) /
          (k ! * (k : ℝ) ^ ((2 - α) * k)) ∧
      (2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) / (k ! * (k : ℝ) ^ ((2 - α) * k)) ≤
        (2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ k * t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) * k) / (k ! : ℝ) ^ (3 - α)) ∧
    ∫ ω, u ω ^ 2 ∂P ≤ Real.exp ((3 - α) * (2 * Zc α₀ * Ksp c α) ^ (1 / (3 - α)) *
      t ^ ((4 - α - α₀) / (3 - α)))

theorem finite_gaussian_matrix_paper {o n : Type*} [Fintype o] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq o]
    [DecidableEq n] [Nonempty o] [Nonempty n] {N : ℕ} (_hN : 1 ≤ N)
    (A : Fin N → Matrix o n ℂ) (g : Fin N → Ω → ℝ) (hind : iIndepFun g P)
    (hlaw : ∀ k, HasLaw (g k) (gaussianReal 0 1) P) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    Integrable (fun ω => schattenPow (gaussLin A (fun k => g k ω)) m) P ∧
      (∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin A (fun k => g k ω)) m ∂P) ^ (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ≤
        √(2 * (m : ℝ) - 1) *
          (((trace (vOut A ^ m)).re + (trace (vIn A ^ m)).re) / 2) ^ (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ∧
      √(2 * (m : ℝ) - 1) *
          (((trace (vOut A ^ m)).re + (trace (vIn A ^ m)).re) / 2) ^ (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ≤
        √(2 * (m : ℝ) - 1) *
          max (schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vOut A)) m) (schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vIn A)) m) ∧
      (m = 1 →
        (∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin A (fun k => g k ω)) m ∂P) ^ (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) =
          √(2 * (m : ℝ) - 1) *
            (((trace (vOut A ^ m)).re + (trace (vIn A ^ m)).re) / 2) ^ (1 / (2 * (m : ℝ))) ∧
        ∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin A (fun k => g k ω)) m ∂P = (trace (vIn A)).re ∧
        (trace (vOut A)).re = (trace (vIn A)).re) ∧
      ((∀ k, A k = 0) →
        ∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin A (fun k => g k ω)) m ∂P = 0 ∧
          ((trace (vOut A ^ m)).re + (trace (vIn A ^ m)).re) / 2 = 0 ∧
          schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vOut A)) m = 0 ∧
          schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vIn A)) m = 0)

        (⨆ ξ, rowIntegral a γ h ν ξ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * C * scaleProfile α h) ∧
        ∀ ξ : Rd d, Integrable (fun l => rowKernel a h ξ (ξ - l)) ν ∧

          ∫ ξ, ‖paperHat (fun x => (zetaR ζ R x : ℂ) • cxS F x) ξ‖ ^ 2 ∂μ ≤

    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha a Γ μ) (hΓ : Γ ≠ 0) :

    0 < CoccO a alpha Γ ∧ CoccO a alpha Γ ≤ K0 a * Rsp Γ alpha ∧
    (∀ u : ℝ → H1R d, IsClassO u →
      0 < T (dgO u) ∧ RawOccupationEnergy.Araw a Γ (gO u) < ⊤ ∧ 0 ≤ A a Γ (gO u) ∧
      A a Γ (gO u) ≤ K0 a * Rsp Γ alpha * T (dgO u) ^ (alpha / 2) ∧
      ∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → ∃ u' : ℝ → H1R d, IsClassO u' ∧
        (∀ᵐ s ∂volI, gO u' s =ᵐ[volume] WeakSobolev.dilL2 ℓ (gO u s)) ∧
        A a Γ (gO u') = ℓ ^ alpha * A a Γ (gO u) ∧ T (dgO u') = ℓ ^ 2 * T (dgO u)) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℝ, 0 < ℓ → ∀ f : Rd d → ℝ,
      WeakSobolev.dilL2 ℓ⁻¹ (WeakSobolev.dilL2 ℓ f) = f) ∧
    ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 < ζ →

      EOO a Γ ζ = Dzeta alpha ζ * CoccO a alpha Γ ^ (2 / (2 - alpha)) ∧
      CoccO a alpha Γ = (2 * EOO a Γ ζ / (2 - alpha)) ^ ((2 - alpha) / 2) *
        (2 * ζ / alpha) ^ (alpha / 2) ∧
      0 < EOO a Γ ζ ∧
      EOO a Γ ζ = ζ ^ (-(alpha / (2 - alpha))) * EOO a Γ 1

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: MixedMoment: the statement of P:mixed (main TeX lines 834-849): the diagram limits exist and are finite, E[X_m X_n] = sum_D J_(m,n,D)(t) with the products integrable, u^2 integrable and E u^2 = sum_k A_k(t); true for the solution under H:homog, not proved (order-two wrapper riesz_small_paper' only).

Note. Wrappers RieszFourDiagrams.riesz_small_paper' (order two; RieszDiagramLimit proved there by rieszDiagramLimit) and riesz_four_paper (order four, nothing supplied); H:homog carried unused. OrderTwoDiagrams.riesz_small_paper (RieszDiagramLimit as input) is superseded. E:riesz-four is for the density diagrams; their identification with diagramLim at order four is not proved.

theorem resolventV_spec {P : H^{1}(Rd d) →L[ℂ] H^{1}(Rd d)} (hP : IsSelfAdjoint P) {k K : ℝ}
    (hk : SignedMultiplierForm P k) (hkK : k ≤ K) (hK : 1 ≤ K) :
    (∀ f w, ⟪formOp P (2 + K ^ 2) w, solV hk hkK hK f⟫_ℂ = ⟪embL2 w, f⟫_ℂ) ∧
    (∀ (f : L²[d]) (u : H^{1}(Rd d)),
      (∀ w, ⟪formOp P (2 + K ^ 2) w, u⟫_ℂ = ⟪embL2 w, f⟫_ℂ) → u = solV hk hkK hK f) ∧
    (∀ f, resolventV hk hkK hK f = embL2 (solV hk hkK hK f)) ∧
    IsSelfAdjoint (resolventV hk hkK hK) ∧ (resolventV hk hkK hK).IsPositive ∧
    ‖resolventV hk hkK hK‖ ≤ 1 ∧ Function.Injective (resolventV hk hkK hK)

    (∀ (f : Rd d → ℝ) (g : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f g →

    (∀ (f h : Rd d → ℝ) (g k : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f g → IsH1Pair h k →

      0 ≤ (pairing Γ (zE fun x => f x ^ 2) (zE fun x => h x ^ 2)).toReal ∧
      (pairing Γ (zE fun x => f x ^ 2) (zE fun x => h x ^ 2)).toReal ≤
        Real.sqrt ((pairing Γ (zE fun x => f x ^ 2) (zE fun x => f x ^ 2)).toReal *
          (pairing Γ (zE fun x => h x ^ 2) (zE fun x => h x ^ 2)).toReal)) ∧
    (∀ (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : Rd d → ℝ) (g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ : Rd d → Rd d), IsH1Pair f₁ g₁ →

        ENNReal.ofReal (SpatialSmoothRatio.R0 Γ alpha * (Nnorm alpha f₁ g₁ *
          Nnorm alpha f₂ g₂ * Nnorm alpha f₃ g₃ * Nnorm alpha f₄ g₄)) ∧
      Integrable (fun p : Rd d × Rd d => f₁ p.1 * f₂ p.1 * f₃ (p.1 - p.2) * f₄ (p.1 - p.2))
        (pairMeasure Γ)) ∧
    (∀ (u₁ u₂ u₃ u₄ : ℕ → Rd d → ℝ) (v₁ v₂ v₃ v₄ : ℕ → Rd d → Rd d)
      (f₁ f₂ f₃ f₄ : Rd d → ℝ) (g₁ g₂ g₃ g₄ : Rd d → Rd d),

theorem spatial_four_linear_multilinear_paper_completed {alpha alpha0 : ℝ}
    {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)} (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (hΓ : Γ ≠ 0)

    (h₄ : IsH1Pair f₄ g₄) (a b : ℝ) :

      C4 Γ f₁ f₂ (fun x => a * f x + b * f' x) f₄ =
        a * C4 Γ f₁ f₂ f f₄ + b * C4 Γ f₁ f₂ f' f₄ ∧
      C4 Γ f₁ f₂ f₃ (fun x => a * f x + b * f' x) =

The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: the bound 100 e^(2 lambda h) for the phase propagator on the coupling disc of radius delta_(alpha/2) lambda^(2-alpha/2)/d', for every d' >= d_n, d' > 0 (lines 3129-3132), supplied in StaticPhaseCauchy; in static_phase_all_orders_cp the circle bound is derived from L:complex-phase and three named inputs: FockSandwich (E:fock-sandwich in operator form), CPInputs (E:cp-input, inverse-root integral) and PropagatorBlock, with positive A_0 and self-adjoint B at every cutoff (supplied, with the named inputs); in FockSandwichModel.static_phase_all_orders_model (wave L12) FockSandwich, A_0 >= 0 and B = B^* are proved on the Fourier-side model, not identified with physical space; the added restriction of static_phase_all_orders_model: an orthonormal real family psi_m of size m in L^2(mu_eps) for every Gaussian cutoff m (so mu != 0; the case mu = 0, where every positive-order term vanishes, lines 3126-3127, is not covered by that wrapper); the phase entries are entire in the coupling (lines 3134-3135); the identification of the n-th coefficient, applied to S_b(f,g) times the vacuum, with the cutoff n-th Duhamel phase via L:finite-word-cutoff (lines 3143-3148), with ||z||_(1/h) <= n ||z||_(n/h) (line 3154); L:finite-word-cutoff is proved with several coordinates per color (FiniteWordCutoff), but the identification of the phase coefficients is not formalized; ||S_b(f,g)||_(n/h) <= ||(f,g)||_(1/h) (line 3155); the removal of the band and Gaussian cutoffs, as convergence of the norms (lines 3168-3192); the free bound ||Z_0(h)||_(1/h) <= sqrt(e) ||(f,g)||_(1/h) (line 3207).

Note. Abstract complex and real Banach spaces stand for L^2(Omega; X_lambda); the wrappers state R_alpha by E:phase-constants and A_alpha = 400 sqrt(2) e^2/delta_(alpha/2) with delta_a = min{1/4, pi/(8 I_a)} proved positive; the Gaussian-polynomial structure and the uniformity in eps are those of the inputs.

theorem variational_positive_scores_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ c, (scoreSet alpha0 Γ c).Nonempty) ∧
    (∀ Ψ ∈ CPos d, IntegrableOn (rate alpha0 Γ Ψ) (Ioo 0 1) ∧ 0 < integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ ∧
      (∀ σ, Integrable (fun x => Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ Ψ σ x) volume) ∧
      IntegrableOn (fun σ => ∫ x, Ψ (σ, x) * mean alpha0 Γ Ψ σ x) (Ioo 0 1) ∧
      0 < rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ) ∧
    (∀ Ψ₀ ∈ CPos d, 0 < testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀ ∧
      dil alpha (testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀) Ψ₀ ∈ CPos d ∧
      integratedRate alpha0 Γ (dil alpha (testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀) Ψ₀) -
          rawCost alpha0 Γ (dil alpha (testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀) Ψ₀) / 2 =
        testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀ * integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ₀ / 2 ∧
      0 < testRadius alpha alpha0 Γ Ψ₀ * integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ₀ / 2) ∧
    (∃ y ∈ score1Set alpha0 Γ, 0 < y) ∧
    (∀ c, 0 < c → ∀ Ψ ∈ CPos d,
      c * integratedRate alpha0 Γ (dil alpha (c ^ (3 - alpha)⁻¹) Ψ) -
          rawCost alpha0 Γ (dil alpha (c ^ (3 - alpha)⁻¹) Ψ) / 2 =
        c ^ ((4 - alpha) / (3 - alpha)) *
          (integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ - rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ / 2)) ∧
    (∀ c, 0 < c →
      scoreSet alpha0 Γ c = c ^ ((4 - alpha) / (3 - alpha)) • scoreSet alpha0 Γ 1) ∧
    (∀ c, 0 < c → (BddAbove (scoreSet alpha0 Γ c) ↔ S1Bdd alpha0 Γ))

A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves the mask family and every rate statement with the section's hypotheses and nothing supplied, for lambda_(R,s) defined as the square root of the real Rayleigh supremum of m_R h_s (compact ground rates not formalized); E:variational-unmasked-point-lower is derived from E:raw-block-original-lower as a supplied input, for a real function in place of the point moment.

theorem variational_remove_mask_paper {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    (hH : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) (hΓ0 : Γ ≠ 0) {Ψ : ℝ × Rd d → ℝ}
    (hΨ : Ψ ∈ CPos d) {L : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hRB : RawBlockOriginalLower alpha0 Γ Ψ (rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ) L) :
    (∀ R, 0 < R →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (mask (d := d) R) ∧ (∀ x : Rd d, mask R (-x) = mask R x) ∧
      (∀ x y : Rd d, ‖x‖ = ‖y‖ → mask R x = mask R y) ∧
      (∀ x : Rd d, 0 ≤ mask R x ∧ mask R x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : Rd d, ‖x‖ ≤ R → mask R x = 1) ∧
      tsupport (mask (d := d) R) ⊆ closedBall 0 (2 * R)) ∧
    (∀ R R', 0 < R → R ≤ R' → ∀ x : Rd d, mask R x ≤ mask R' x) ∧
    (∀ x : Rd d, Tendsto (fun R => mask R x) atTop (𝓝 1)) ∧
    (∃ ε M C R₀ : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ε ≤ M ∧ 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < R₀ ∧
      (∀ R, R₀ ≤ R → ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s)).Nonempty ∧
        BddAbove (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s)) ∧
        ε ≤ sSup (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s)) ∧
        sSup (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s)) ≤ M ∧
        maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s ^ 2 = sSup (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s)) ∧
        Real.sqrt ε ≤ maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s ∧ maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s ≤ Real.sqrt M) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ R R', 0 < R → R ≤ R' →
        maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s ≤ maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R' s ∧
        maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R' s ≤ rate alpha0 Γ Ψ s) ∧
      (∀ R, R₀ ≤ R → ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        |maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s - maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R t| ≤
          C / (2 * Real.sqrt ε) * |s - t|) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        sSup ((fun R => sSup (rayleighSet (maskedMean alpha0 Γ Ψ R s))) '' Ici R₀) =
          sSup (rayleighSet (mean alpha0 Γ Ψ s))) ∧
      (∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
        Tendsto (fun R => maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s) atTop (𝓝 (rate alpha0 Γ Ψ s))) ∧
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun R s => maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R s) (rate alpha0 Γ Ψ) atTop (Icc 0 1) ∧
      (∀ R, R₀ ≤ R → IntegrableOn (maskedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R) (Ioo 0 1)) ∧
      (∀ R R', R₀ ≤ R → R ≤ R' →
        maskedIntegratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R ≤ maskedIntegratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R' ∧
        maskedIntegratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ R' ≤ integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ) ∧
      Tendsto (maskedIntegratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ) atTop (𝓝 (integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ))) ∧
    ((2 * integratedRate alpha0 Γ Ψ - rawCost alpha0 Γ Ψ / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) ≤
      liminf (fun T => (L T : EReal)) atTop

Hypotheses.     (∀ k, ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 2 ∂P = 1 ∧ ∫ ω, g k ω ^ 4 ∂P = 3) ∧
    ∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin (rowFamily 16) (fun k => g k ω)) 2 ∂P = 288 ∧
    ¬ ((∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin (rowFamily 16) (fun k => g k ω)) 2 ∂P) ^
          (1 / (2 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
        √(2 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) * schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vIn (rowFamily 16))) 2) ∧
    ∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin (colFamily 16) (fun k => g k ω)) 2 ∂P = 288 ∧
    ¬ ((∫ ω, schattenPow (gaussLin (colFamily 16) (fun k => g k ω)) 2 ∂P) ^
          (1 / (2 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ))) ≤
        √(2 * ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) - 1) * schattenNorm (CFC.sqrt (vOut (colFamily 16))) 2)

Note. Route: a finite-cell selection replaces the countable one, space-time Cauchy-Schwarz replaces rho_g in H_I. The class O itself in ClassOBridge (wave L14); the zero case Gamma = 0 is proved except C_2 = 0, the vanishing of S_c^pos and of the original means, and Q = 0 (ClassOBridge.zero_covariance_paper); the K_0 R_sp form (wave L8) remains. Le's decision of 2026-11-12 covered that L8 form.

Theorem T:white-moment-bounds: Explicit white moment bounds

Not yet verified. lean-pkg's record of the checks says: out-of-scope, unknown. Until it says verified, read the Lean statement below as work in progress.

Conclusion. A weaker statement than the paper's: Lean proves E:white-moment-bounds for the variational value S_2^pos in place of C_2(c,a) (identified by T:intrinsic-second-moment), for c > 0 and 0 < a < 1, with the value E_sp = c^2/6 of P:white-spatial-energy supplied (each bound uses one inequality of it), and that M_a, K_0(a) and both bound formulas are positive; the time exponent sentence and the case c = 0 are not formalized.

Hypotheses. The paper's, plus these, which the Lean statement assumes and the paper proves or assumes elsewhere: P:white-spatial-energy (integrated_white_evaluation.tex lines 79-133): the spatial energy of c delta_0 is c^2/6 for c > 0; the lower bound uses only c^2/6 <= E_sp (the sech profile, lines 106-124), the upper bound only E_sp <= c^2/6 (the CDF square, lines 88-100 and 117-121); reserved package B9, not proved.

Note. TeX route: the bracket of C:intrinsic-spatial-bracket (nothing supplied) at the white model (H:homog with alpha = d = 1, Gamma != 0 for c > 0, proved) and the arithmetic of lines 154-161. On the upper half also S_2^pos <= 2^m F_0(E_(1/2)^O) <= the upper formula, via the exact C_occ (OccupationCeilingExact) over the class O modelled by joint representatives, not identified with the TeX's class.

Citation

Le Chen. stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean: Lean companion to the second moment of the Stratonovich hyperbolic Anderson model. Version 0.10.0. doi:10.5281/zenodo.24199104.
